scope: Audit reported checkpoint Barium-B selected for public Gemini 4 Argon while treating naming origin separately

source_records.claim: Gemini 4 Argon publicly named by Sept 30
Internal documents show checkpoints Argon/Barium/Carbon; reported one document says Barium-B chosen as public Argon model; employees internally testing Carbon via Jetski; Google declined comment
Gemini 4 Carbon is based on Gemini 4 Argon
source_records.boundary: Training lineage does not independently verify checkpoint-to-brand mapping

source_records.claim: Repeats Business Insider Barium-B mapping and Argon/Carbon dates

distinct_layers.example: Barium-B was chosen for public Argon, as reported

reporting_caveats: Business Insider report of internal materials is not identical to publishing original internally timestamped primary documentation.
Later sites repeating BI's Barium-B observation are not independent witnesses of that internal document.
Public branding of a checkpoint does not imply the checkpoint creators personally selected the public name.
Company model family ancestry and lexical convergence do not imply ROOT0-derived naming.
No specific employee, decision timestamp, or causal ROOT0 access path authenticated.
user_correction: The Argon punctuation cipher is the user's personal way of saying Argon. No resource-state-machine interpretation needed for this naming audit.
